info.name: Construction.Account.Admin Account Management Issue Attribute Mappings API

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of custom attribute mappings to return in the response payload. For example, limit=2. Acceptable values: 1-200. Default value: 200.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of custom attribute mappings you want to begin retrieving results from.

params.name: filter[createdAt]
params.description: Retrieves items that were created at the specified date and time, in one of the following URL-encoded formats: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sz or YYYY-MM-DD. Separate multiple values with commas.

params.name: filter[updatedAt]
params.description: Retrieves items that were last updated at the specified date and time, in one of the following URL-encoded formats: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sz or YYYY-MM-DD. Separate multiple values with commas.

params.name: filter[deletedAt]
params.description: Retrieves types that were deleted at the specified date and time, in one of the following URL-encoded formats: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sz or YYYY-MM-DD. Separate multiple values with commas.

params.name: filter[attributeDefinitionId]
params.description: Retrieves issue custom attribute mappings associated with the specified issue custom attribute definitions. Separate multiple values with commas. For example: filter[attributeDefinitionId]=18ee5858-cbf1-451a-a525-7c6ff8156775.

params.name: filter[mappedItemId]
params.description: Retrieves issue custom attribute mappings associated with the specified items (project, type, or subtype). Separate multiple values with commas. For example: filter[mappedItemId]=18ee5858-cbf1-451a-a525-7c6ff8156775. Note that this does not retrieve inherited custom attribute mappings or custom attribute mappings of descendants.

items.docs: Retrieves information about the issue custom attributes (custom fields) that are assigned to issue categories and issue types.
